Logo & website

My Leads

Private lead pipeline -- stays exclusive to you until converted to a deal

Leads you capture here are 100% yours until you convert one to a registered deal. Once converted, it goes to the Operator for approval but stays on your account. This keeps your pipeline private and prevents deal poaching.

MSP Prospecting

Thailand MSPs and VARs to approach about vendor partner programs

Every company here is real. Apollo.io ones were found with an Apollo lookup; Web research ones through public sources (software directories, partner locators, company sites). All were then researched from public pages -- open Sources on each card. Contacts are general company addresses; find the right person before a formal invitation. Blank fields weren't published anywhere we could check. Software house covers software and app developers -- a natural fit for API partnerships such as Botnoi Voice.
